breaking: validate, onComplete, onStepChange and useStepWizard moved to step-wizard-client (StepWizard and StepWizardStep with the same names)
steps are <details name>; StepWizardStep must be a direct child of StepWizard
without onComplete the Finish button is type=submit and submits the surrounding form
Next is locked by native validity (fieldset:has(:invalid)): required, pattern, minLength
only the entering step animates; there is no exit animation and slide no longer follows the direction
the progress bar is decorative (aria-hidden); the step number is read from a visually hidden text in the title

how.en: <details name> steps, neighbour summaries as Back and Next
how.ru: Шаги на <details name>, summary соседей служат кнопками
